purpose: Design concepts, fictional sample data; not game screenshots
prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity concept image of a World of Warcraft Forever guild materials addon. Modern clean WoW aesthetic: dark slate panels, restrained antique gold thin borders, small authentic fantasy material icons, readable cream sans serif typography, no ornate heavy frame. Landscape 1600x1000 composition, single centered addon window almost fills image on muted charcoal background. Spanish UI. Working title "GuildStock" top left with small subtitle "Materiales de hermandad", close X top right. Top navigation "Materiales", "Mi inventario", "Ajustes". Main three-column layout: narrow left navigation, middle material list, wider right selected material detail. Left: "Para mis profesiones" highlighted, "Todos los materiales", "Favoritos", divider then "PROFESIONES", "Alquimia", "Herrería", "Ingeniería", "Sastrería". Middle search input "Buscar material..." above list with small square icons and names "Barra de cobre", "Mineral de cobre", "Piedra burda", "Paño de lino". Selected row "Barra de cobre" muted gold highlight. Right panel icon and large title "Barra de cobre", subtitle "Herrería · Ingeniería", favorite star. Subtle text "Existencias compartidas · No implica oferta de venta". Table exact columns "Jugador", "Bolsas", "Banco", "Datos", with fictional rows "Aldren | 40 | 120 | Hace 1 min", "Mirel | 18 | 60 | Hace 3 min", "Brannoc | 25 | — | Hace 2 min". A fourth dimmed row "Elowen | 10 | 80 | Hace 2 días", label "Desconectado". Under table useful explanation "Banco: última visita conocida" and "— Sin datos de banco". Bottom right discreet button "Susurrar", never buy/sell prices. Footer "Compartiendo bolsas y banco" with green small dot and secondary button "Actualizar". Bottom outside window small "Concepto visual · Datos de ejemplo". Make this feel implementable with normal WoW addon frames, crisp balanced usable visual hierarchy. All player names fictional and quantities sample; no claims screenshot actual game. Do not add graphs, currency, web browser controls, huge display slogans.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity companion concept image for a World of Warcraft Forever guild materials addon named "GuildStock". Modern clean WoW aesthetic: dark slate panels, thin restrained antique gold borders, small fantasy item icons, cream highly readable sans-serif type. Landscape 1600x1000, single large centered window on charcoal background, no game background or browser. Top left "GuildStock" and subtitle "Materiales de hermandad", close X. Tabs "Materiales", "Mi inventario" selected, "Ajustes". Show an inventory transparency screen with top explanation "Estas existencias se comparten con tu hermandad." and muted second line "Tener un material no implica ofrecerlo en venta." Three restrained summary cards: "Bolsas" / "Actualizadas hace 15 s"; "Banco" / "Última visita hace 2 días" amber clock; "Sincronización" / "Activa" green dot. Search "Buscar en mis materiales..." above a clean large table. Table columns "Material", "Bolsas", "Banco", "Total conocido". Four rows with fantasy material icons "Barra de cobre | 40 | 120 | 160", "Mineral de cobre | 12 | 30 | 42", "Paño de lino | 24 | 60 | 84", "Piedra burda | 8 | 0 | 8". Beneath table a warm understated info panel: "El banco conserva el último recuento comprobado." second line "Visita el banco para actualizarlo." Bottom footer left "Solo materiales de profesión", right button "Pausar publicación". Comfortable spacing, tight usable real addon proportions. Small outside-window caption "Concepto visual · Datos de ejemplo". No coins, price, buy/sell buttons, analytics charts, marketing headlines, characters or real player data. This image should show the companion screen to a directory of guild materials, not a different app.
